subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PR.INT.
description: Second diagram on page 469, paired with OP-SPD × POL-P above. Where the first diagram shows the structural shape of western-art-music's always-already-there funding, this one names what projectional-dynamics meets when it actually goes out into the world without that funding: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) crossed with PR-INT (the primary intention). PROJ-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; its main line runs right to PR-INT, the partner-axis. (R)OBS (the reality of observation) rises from the main line, with INFO-DY (information dynamics) branching from OBS's line and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) from INFO-DY's line. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from the main line near PR-INT, with RT-DY (reality dynamics) branching from T-C-IMP's line and MOT-DY from RT-DY's line. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) drops from the main line to the bottom-center, with AFI (affinity insight) branching from SPT-DY's line and PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) from AFI's line.
